gloss: winning record; more wins than losses; go-ahead (score)

definitions.gloss: winning record; more wins than losses
definitions.explanation: Having more wins than losses in a series of matches or over a season. Especially prominent in sumo, where achieving 勝ち越し (8 or more wins in a 15-bout tournament) determines a wrestler's ranking.
Scoring the goal or run that puts one's team ahead of the opponent in a game.

examples.japanese: {今場所|こんばしょ}は{勝|か}ち{越|こ}しを{決|き}めた。
examples.english: He secured a winning record this tournament.

examples.japanese: 8{勝|しょう}7{敗|はい}でぎりぎり{勝|か}ち{越|こ}した。
examples.english: He barely got a winning record with 8 wins and 7 losses.

examples.japanese: {新入幕|しんにゅうまく}で{勝|か}ち{越|こ}しを{果|は}たすのは{簡単|かんたん}ではない。
examples.english: It's not easy to achieve a winning record in your first tournament in the top division.

examples.japanese: 9{回|かい}に{勝|か}ち{越|こ}し{点|てん}を{入|い}れた。
examples.english: They scored the go-ahead run in the 9th inning.

examples.japanese: {後半|こうはん}{終了|しゅうりょう}{間際|まぎわ}に{勝|か}ち{越|こ}しゴールを{決|き}めた。
examples.english: They scored the go-ahead goal just before the end of the second half.

examples.japanese: {延長戦|えんちょうせん}で{勝|か}ち{越|こ}しのホームランを{打|う}って、チームを{勝利|しょうり}に{導|みちび}いた。
examples.english: He hit a go-ahead home run in extra innings and led the team to victory.

notes:
A sports term with particular significance in sumo wrestling. In sumo, each tournament ({場所|ばしょ}) has 15 bouts, and a wrestler who wins 8 or more achieves {勝|か}ち{越|こ}し, which generally results in a promotion in the rankings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {勝|か}ち{越|こ}しを{決|き}める: to clinch a winning record
- {勝|か}ち{越|こ}しを{果|は}たす: to achieve a winning record
- {勝|か}ち{越|こ}し{点|てん}: go-ahead run/point
- {勝|か}ち{越|こ}しゴール: go-ahead goal

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {負|ま}け{越|こ}し: losing record; more losses than wins — the counterpart in sumo and other sports
